A '''model''' of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|floating]], four-[[Limb/Legends|limbed]] [[Science droid/Legends|science droid]]<ref name="Complete Season Two" /> was in use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="ZBSB" />

==History==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] when the newly-awakened [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] was brought to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in order to harvest its secrets and seeming indestructibility, a science droid was used by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sionver Boll/Legends|Sionver Boll]] to run tests on the Zillo Beast. It drew [[Blood/Legends|blood]] samples using a syringe attachment, as well as emitting fumes derived from the [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] of Malastare, the only known weapon against the creature. The experiments angered the beast, causing it to break free and [[Zillo Beast incident/Legends|wreak havoc]] across the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]].<ref name="ZBSB" />

After [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] staged "assassination" death around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Unidentified science droid/Legends|one of these]] [[Medical droid/Legends|medical]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] helped him shave his head and administered him an injection of nanotechnology to transform into the likeness of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]].<ref name="Deception" />
